summary: Action Spine extraction remains a gated future package step. Konoha now has explicit in-repo generic core types, port interfaces, host vocabulary boundaries, and package-readiness blockers, but no runtime package split is claimed before workflow semantic stabilization and release gates.
target_invariant: Generic Action Spine core and ports define reusable shapes and host seams only. Konoha action IDs, scopes, policy defaults, runtime adapters, storage, workflow, agent, route, and MCP bridge behavior remain host-owned until the semantic and release gates close.

accepted_child_issues.title: Define Action Spine core port interfaces in Konoha before package extraction
Split Konoha action vocabulary from generic Action Spine core types
Update #618 with extraction readiness checklist and blockers
Add package extraction spike after semantic stabilization

acceptance_coverage.requirement: Core Action Spine port and type boundary remains generic.
acceptance_coverage.notes: Core files define reusable action shapes, executor/audit/autonomy/HTTP/MCP ports, and have no concrete Konoha action vocabulary imports.

acceptance_coverage.requirement: Konoha-specific action vocabulary stays outside generic core.
acceptance_coverage.notes: Concrete action IDs such as workflow.deploy, case.start, and role.create remain host vocabulary.

acceptance_coverage.requirement: ADR, checklist, and spike docs state extraction blockers and post-stabilization plan.
acceptance_coverage.notes: #618 remains blocked by #684/#685/#686 acceptance and package-specific bridge tests.

acceptance_coverage.requirement: No runtime/package extraction is claimed before semantic gates and release policy are satisfied.
acceptance_coverage.notes: The accepted outcome is readiness evidence only; Konoha runtime adapters remain in src/.

required_before_extraction: #684 accepted: extraction readiness umbrella closed by review
#685 accepted: assistant-created workflow golden path proves create -> validate -> deploy -> run
#686 accepted: final release gate and rollback runbook sign off production readiness
#618 accepted or updated with package extraction PR-specific readiness
package-local bridge tests prove MCP/HTTP adapters use injected ports instead of Konoha imports
blocked_runtime_moves: Do not move src/action-executor.ts into generic core.
Do not move src/action-definitions.ts into generic package vocabulary.
Do not extract src/act-envelope.ts or src/mcp-action-bridge.ts until auth, audit, autonomy, executor, caller context, token, and registry dependencies are injected and tested.

closure_decision.notes: Closing #684 records the extraction readiness boundary after #741-#744. It does not authorize package extraction, runtime movement, or release.
